theme: Light Theme Default (Editorial Clinical Data Lab)

headings.style: Serif, Authoritative, High-Contrast Weights (Light or Bold)
headings.usage: H1, H2, Hero statements, Page titles

data.usage: Model metrics, SHAP values, probabilities, form inputs, table cells

typography.rules: Never use Inter for headings. Keep tight letter spacing (tracking-tighter) for H1/H2.

colors.rules: Avoid gradients. No generic SaaS purple/blue. Do NOT use #1B93A4 (Teal) or #7351B7. Rely on flat, solid clinical colors.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Flat solid surfaces. Medical apps must avoid glassmorphism to prevent data refraction. Use opaque backgrounds.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border (border-black/10). Sharp corners (rounded-none or rounded-sm).
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal to none. Use shadow-sm strictly for hover feedback on cards or buttons.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise/grain overlay on the hero section background to emulate medical paper.

forms.layout: Dense high-density grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4). Group inputs by clinical category.
forms.styling: Flat inputs, 1px solid border, no inner shadow. Use Shadcn components.
forms.typography: Labels: text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-text_secondary. Inputs: IBM Plex Mono.

badges.styling: Sharp edges, solid flat background, high contrast text.

result_gauge.library: Recharts PieChart (180 to 0 degrees) or SVG arc.
result_gauge.styling: Thick stroke (12px-16px). Color dictated by risk level. Center text uses huge IBM Plex Mono percentage.

comparison_tables.layout: Dense, tabular design. Full width, border-collapse with border-b on rows.
comparison_tables.typography: Header: text-xs uppercase. Cells: IBM Plex Mono text-sm.
comparison_tables.highlighting: Highlight best model (e.g., Voting/Stacking) with a subtle bg-[#EBEBE8] or a 'BEST' badge.

grids.home: Asymmetrical 'Tetris' grid. Mix large clinical imagery with dense text blocks. Wide gaps (gap-8).
grids.dashboard: High Density Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4). Every pixel utilized, tight gaps (gap-4). No jagged bottoms.

layouts.spacing: Generous (p-12, p-16) for Home and About pages. Dense and compact (p-4, p-6) for Predict, Result, and EDA Dashboard.
layouts.alignment: Left-align dense content and forms. Optical alignment for icons.

motion.interactions: Subtle and precise. Hover states should feature slight color shifts and 1px border darkens.
motion.animations: Use staggered fades for dashboard cards and form fields on mount.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA/WCAG AA contrast. Never rely on color alone (use text + icon for risk levels).
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='predict-btn').

media.strategy: Use scientific, microscopic, or clean lab imagery. No generic tech vectors.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Use Recharts for all standard data visualizations (EDA, ROC, Feature Importance). No 3D libraries needed; keep it 2D and clinically precise.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design a distinct 'Clinical Journal' aesthetic. Do NOT use generic purple/blue SaaS gradients.
Never use purely transparent backgrounds on headers or overlays. Use solid #F4F4F0 or #FFFFFF.
All files must be .js or .jsx, NOT .tsx.
Use Shadcn UI components but heavily customize them to look flat, removing heavy rounded corners and shadows.
Ensure Recharts components use IBM Plex Mono for axis labels and tooltips.
Add informative tooltips for clinical acronyms (e.g., SG, AL, PC) in the Prediction form.
Add 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements, forms, and key metric displays.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy (use flat surfaces with hard borders).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Target specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like sharp cornered buttons with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable on marketing pages.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: Consistency is key: stick to the defined typography scales and color palette.
Provide clear feedback for user actions (loading states on prediction submit, success toasts).
Keep cognitive load low by logically grouping the 24 clinical features in the Prediction form.
Ensure the result page explicitly displays the medical disclaimer prominently alongside the prediction.
